CustomField.description: Fully qualified LWC name rendered when Component Type is Lightning Web Component, e.g. c:myCustomWidget or namespace:componentName. Passed to c-lwc-section-renderer as component-name; the named component must expose @api record and @api objectApiName (Form_Submission__c) and may emit formfieldchange events, which the section feeds into the live merge record for {{merge}} fields.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the fully qualified name of the custom Lightning Web Component to render, like c:myCustomWidget. The component must implement @api record and @api objectApiName; set Component Type to Lightning Web Component for it to display.
CustomField.label: LWC Component Name
